name: Special Meeting of the City Council and Housing Element Task Force - PART 2
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special Meeting of the City Council and Housing Element Task Force - PART 2
AGENDA
SATURDAY, DECEMBER 16, 2017 -
08:30 AM
a.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL City Council: Mayor Blakespear, Deputy Mayor Kranz, Council Members Boerner Horvath, Mosca, and Muir
Housing Element Task Force: Mayor Blakespear, Deputy Mayor Kranz, Bruce Ehlers, and Kurt Groseclose
2.
AGENDA ITEMS Housing Element Task Force/City Council continued discussion regarding the Housing Plan Update and associated analysis to achieve a State-certified Housing Element. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Staff and the Housing Element Task Force (HETF) recommend that the Council 1) Discuss and provide comments on the sites proposed for inclusion as part of the Housing Element Update and give direction to the HETF regarding their work efforts; and 2) Direct staff to return with a new contract or contract amendment with Kimley-Horn, and a budget adjustment for Council review and approval for completion of the a draft Housing Element.
3.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
